messages:
Maya (PM): Customer X asked to onboard a fine-tuned Llama sha and requested a 3-month pin. They need p95 <=120ms@512 and rerank parity. Can we outline an onramp + pin plan?
Raj (Eng): Need their eval set + short traffic dump. If quantized fp16 we'll likely need a kernel perf check. Also confirm KV cache semantics.
Sam (CSE): I'll request a 48h traffic export and a 1k-query eval slice now. Customer said they'd accept a 2-week grace migration.
Ana (ML): Proposed gates: rerank delta <=2% vs baseline; NER hallucination <=baseline; p95 latency <=1.3x of verified profile; embedding cosine delta <0.02. Fail any = block.
Leo (SRE): For hard pins we must reserve capacity and attach rollback SLAs and an ops calendar slot for canaries. Soft pin allows fallback under overload.
Raj (Eng): Pin policy sketch: soft-pin = preferred routing but allow fallback; hard-pin = reserved routing, always to sha. Default soft unless they buy reserved capacity.
Maya (PM): Negotiation: offer 90d soft pin + migration plan; push for reserved commit to enable hard pin. Sam please push.
Sam (CSE): Customer prioritizes stability. Likely to accept 90d soft pin if we give a clear migration runway and API stability guarantees.
Ana (ML): I'll queue the onramp suite (QA, rerank, perplexity, latency). ETA 48h. Gate behavior: quality=block on fail; latency warn at 1.3x, block at 1.5x.
Raj (Eng): I'll add perf metadata to the catalog (model_sha, quant, fp_type, p95_512, mem_gb, kv_notes). Can prototype pin_ttl/pin_type flags in console by EOD.
Leo (SRE): Rollout plan: 5% for 6h -> 25% for 12h -> 100% with monitors (latency_p95, rerank_delta, 5xx). Auto-rollback if rerank drift >2% or 5xx spike >0.5%.
Maya (PM): Action items: Ana run eval (48h), Raj add perf entry + kernel check (48h), Leo reserve tentative pool + calendar (3bd), Sam get eval data and negotiate (24h).
Raj (Eng): Example rollout snippet:
```
rollout:
  phases:
    - pct: 5; duration: 6h; monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta, 5xx_rate]
    - pct: 25; duration: 12h; monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta]
    - pct: 100; duration: 24h; monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta]
fallback_policy: soft_fallback_enabled: true
```
Maya (PM): Pin rules: hard pin requires reserved capacity + signed SLA. Soft pin = 90d TTL + weekly eval reports. Any pin >90d needs exec approval.
Ana (ML): Safety addendum: if production signals show regression despite offline passing, trigger emergency rollback + audit.
Sam (CSE): Update: Customer agrees to 90d soft pin given migration plan. We'll present reserved option.
Maya (PM): Decision: proceed with 90d soft pin, run onramp + canary, offer reserved capacity to upgrade to hard pin within 14d. Owners: Maya (track), Raj (routing).
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1923459900 (5% traffic)  will post status to #eng-runtime.
Leo (SRE): I'll set alerts and cost estimate for reserved option.
Raj (Eng): Add catalog flags: pin_ttl, pin_type in console. Prototype API by EOD.
Maya (PM): I'll add notes to the onboarding ticket and review in Monday sync. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
